data.name: 1,2-Dichlorobenzene with Water
measurement_methods: The water content was determined by tritium assay.
The count rates were determined using a typical liquid scintillator solution technique.
mixing_methods: Tritiated water was shaken with 1,2-dichlorobenzene in 1:10 volume ratios for 4 hours in a flask in a water thermostat bath.

publication_references.citation: Jones, J.R.; Monk, C.B., J. Chem. Soc. 1963, 2633-5.
